## Goal

Create the build branch and a progress workflow that survives context resets, compactions, shutdowns and stopped tasks.

## Done when

The branch exists. Any agent finds the tracker from the repo root, `code/` or a new Claude Code session.

## Files

- docs/build/README.md, docs/build/PROGRESS.md, docs/build/tasks/_TEMPLATE.md, docs/build/plans/phase-0.md (new)
- AGENTS.md (new, repo root)
- .claude/settings.json (new: SessionStart hook)
- .claude/CLAUDE.md (pointer, repo map line, branch rule now `feat/app-build`)
- code/AGENTS.md (pointer at top)

## Steps

- [x] 1. T00 `git checkout -b feat/app-build` from clean `main`
- [x] 2. T01 create docs/build files

## Evidence

- `git branch --show-current` → `feat/app-build`
- `grep -n "docs/build/PROGRESS.md" .claude/CLAUDE.md code/AGENTS.md AGENTS.md` → 3 hits (lines 5, 1, 3)
- Settings JSON parses; hook command run in exec form with CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR set → exit 0, prints "BUILD TRACKER ..." then PROGRESS.md
- Resume drill (fresh read-only subagent, prompt "resume the build"): found AGENTS.md → PROGRESS.md → README.md; stated phase 0, task T04, next action = owner commit approval, then T05. Its notes: drill step lacked evidence (fixed here); plan said matcher `startup|resume|clear|compact` but settings omit it (intended, see Decisions).
- Not yet verified: the hook firing inside a real new session or after /compact (owner to check)

## Decisions

- Hook uses exec form (`command: node`, `args`) so it runs the same under PowerShell and Git Bash.
- Matcher omitted so the tracker is injected on every session start type, including `compact`.
